description: This source file defines the ElasticsearchIndexProfileHandler class, which manages validation and initialization of Elasticsearch index profiles within the OrchardCore project. It handles index metadata, mapping, and query configuration.

classes.name: ElasticsearchIndexProfileHandler
classes.description: Handles validation and initialization of Elasticsearch index profiles, including metadata management and index mapping validation.

methods.name: ValidatingAsync
methods.description: Validates the index profile, ensuring proper index name and presence of index mappings.

methods.name: InitializingAsync
methods.description: Initializes the index profile by populating metadata and configuration settings.

methods.name: PopulateAsync
methods.description: Populates index metadata with data from JSON, including mappings, analyzers, and search fields.
